name: hub-spoke-network
description: Enterprise hub-and-spoke topology with Azure Firewall, Bastion, forced tunneling, and a peered workload spoke.
what: A hub virtual network hosting a zone-redundant Azure Firewall (with firewall policy), Azure Bastion, and a gateway subnet, peered to a workload spoke whose default route (0.0.0.0/0) is forced through the firewall. Diagnostics flow to Log Analytics.
why: Centralized egress inspection, no public IPs on workloads, and a single audited path to the internet are baseline requirements for regulated landing zones. This is the connectivity substrate every other workload peers into.
potentialUseCases: Connectivity subscription for an Azure landing zone
Forced-tunnel egress inspection for regulated workloads (PCI, HIPAA, IRAP)
Secure jump-box access to private VMs via Bastion without public IPs
Central firewall policy shared across multiple spokes

reliability: Azure Firewall and public IPs deployed across availability zones
Spoke peering survives independent workload redeploys
security: All spoke egress forced through Azure Firewall for inspection
NSG denies inbound internet to the workload subnet
Bastion removes the need for public IPs on workloads
Premium firewall tier (prod) enables TLS inspection and IDPS
costOptimization: Bastion is optional and disabled in dev
Standard firewall tier in dev, Premium only in prod
operationalExcellence: Firewall logs and metrics streamed to Log Analytics
Firewall rules centralized in a reusable firewall policy
performanceEfficiency: Zone-redundant firewall scales automatically with throughput
Spoke subnets sized with CIDR functions to avoid overlap

cost.profile: Resilient hub with Premium firewall and Bastion (prod profile).

components.name: Azure Firewall (Premium)
components.notes: Per-deployment hourly charge; data processing billed separately.
